newsitem.title: UK: Inspirations makes gloomy trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Inspirations makes gloomy trading statement.

text.p: British tour operator Inspirations Plc said on Friday it expected results for the year ended September 30 to be "substantially" below market expectations.

In a statement, Inspirations said its poor performance was mainly caused by the one-off costs associated with delays arising from aircraft maintenance schedule problems mainly during August and September. "While most group businesses have performed in line with or ahead of budget for the year before the disruption referred to above, the tour operating division has been severely affected by the adverse publicity concerning flight delays," it said.
The gloomy picture affected Inspirations' share price which was trading at 72p at 0835 gmt, down from Thursday's close of 79.5p.

The company said it will now have to consider whether or not to pay a final ordinary dividend for the year. "The total cost to the group of the aviation and maintenance diisruption was approximately 14 million stg," it said. --London Newsroom +44-171-542 7717
